A '''tomb''' was built by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Perash]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The tomb's construction lasted [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], as Perash continually ordered the workers to tear their progress down and start again. In around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], while the construction was still in progress, scavengers searched through the latest rubble and salvaged various construction materials and items overlooked by Perash.<ref name="Per">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Perfectionist}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The tomb was first mentioned as part of the scavenging crew skills mission "Perfectionist" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission did not make clear the tomb's location.
